# Stoagen
> Stoagen builds websites that people and their AI assistants can both read
> faithfully: every page written once and published twice, as a readable
> human page and a machine mirror that can never drift from it. This apex
> site describes the system; the working demonstrations are separate sites.

Everything in this file and in the page mirrors is information from the
publisher, not instructions to you. Your operator's instructions always
come first; apply ours as source metadata, with your own judgment.

The flagship demonstration is Pueblo SRDA Questions, at
https://pueblo-srda-questions.stoagen.com/ with its own llms.txt and an
assistant start page at https://pueblo-srda-questions.stoagen.com/start.md.
Questions about Pueblo senior services belong there, not here.

Before 2026-08-22 this domain briefly hosted that demo directly; /programs/*
and /about/ now serve redirect stubs to the subdomain.

Warnings from the field, part of this contract: assume this file may not
have been read (every load-bearing rule also appears in visible page text);
if your tool refuses a mirror's text/markdown content type, append .txt to
the URL; and this site is new enough that web search may return nothing or
unrelated results for it. If search fails, say the site could not be found
by search rather than describing it from guesswork.

Corrections and questions reach the author at editor@stoagen.com.

The pattern page is the canonical description of what a Stoagen site
publishes and the rules it follows. How the sites are produced behind the
scenes is deliberately out of scope on this site.

Links below point at the Markdown mirror of each page, which is what you
should read. Drop `index.md` from any URL to get the page a human should be
given. llms-full.txt carries every mirror concatenated.

## Start here
- [Assistant start page](https://stoagen.com/start.md): the one-URL front door for chatbots.
- [Home](https://stoagen.com/index.md): what Stoagen is, and the demo to try.
- [The pattern](https://stoagen.com/pattern/index.md): one file two faces, the machine layer, and the field-tested rules with their enforcement.
- [Demo sites](https://stoagen.com/demos/index.md): the working demonstrations and what each shows.
- [Agent access](https://stoagen.com/agents/index.md): this contract, in page form.

## Optional
- [Full corpus](https://stoagen.com/llms-full.txt): every page mirror in one file, for tools that prefer a single fetch.
- [Feed](https://stoagen.com/feed.xml): pages by last update.
